The company has market cap of $551.24 million. The companyÂ’s deposit products include demand, interest-bearing transaction accounts, money market accounts, certificates of deposit, municipal deposits, savings, and deposit accounts. It has a 17.51 P/E ratio. The firm also provides consumer lending solutions, including first mortgage real estate loans, home equity loans, and other personal loans; small business administration and commercial loans; and single-family residential mortgage loans and construction loans for residential and commercial purposes.
